scope: 1次元の次に2次元動的Fenwick Treeの2周目を比較。main・共通I/O・初期点/照会順を固定。

environment.method: コア別lock・候補乱択交互実行・同一baseline実行binarycontrol。周波数は固定しない。

decision.prefix_updates: 固定32/16スロットの条件加算を有効suffix/容量suffixだけの加算へ変える2案。18公式ケース7回でmany_points約3.5%、max_random約2.3〜2.6%後退。反復更新も約82〜104%後退し不採用。
decision.AVX2_position: 子選択の比較maskからcountr_one/popcountを使う2案。単体約6〜16%短縮でも固定main native18件5回・generic18件3回に安定した全体短縮なし。不採用。SIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD時はpreprocessed tokensがbaseline一致。
decision.outer_rows: 整数の左右行走査を独立累積し1/2段ずつ交互に扱う2案。18公式ケース7回で大規模は概ね±1%またはcontrolと同程度。追加コードの採用根拠がなく不採用。非整数の加算順は実験版でも維持。
decision.production: 本体・公開API・1D共有部品・main・共通I/Oは変更しない。追加の速度改善は主張しない。公開APIの所有/コピー失敗/再利用の独立テストだけ補足する。

prefix/summary.json.decision: reject both prefix-store candidates; production unchanged

changes.valid_suffix: DirectReads=false existing-key leaf update p..count-1 and parent update position..count-1; DirectReads=true retains fixed32/16 loops.
changes.capacity_suffix: DirectReads=false loops p..32/position..16; no zero-add beforeposition; DirectReads=true retains oldloops.

prefix/summary.json.rationale: Fixed-main many_points +3.5%, max_random +2.3~2.6%, many_queries +2.0~2.1% againstsamebinarycontrol near±0.4%. Isolated existing-key updates are81.9~104.2% slower. Fewerstores lose to fixedwidth auto-vectorization. No fullcandidate sanitizer/matrix rerun justified for rejectedprototype.
prefix/summary.json.shared_definition_note: If adopted, sharedBPlus class wouldneed synchronization into1Dfile andinclude-order checks. Rejectedso noproduction sync needed.

position/report.json.decision: reject both manual AVX2 position candidates; production unchanged

isolated.type: leaf32 or inner16; sorted uint32 keys and UINT32_MAX sentinels
isolated.result: mask about4-13% faster; popcount about6-16% faster than native autovec, samebinary control roughly±1%
isolated.source_note: Initial isolated source has equivalent mask8 lambda within AVX2-target helper. Final header spells the four loads explicitly to support generic compilation; fixedmain measurements below use that final header.

fixed_main.note: main/sharedIO frozen; no phase-separated diagnostic main used as submitted performance value

position/report.json.environment: Intel i9-14900K P-Core12, /usr/bin/g++15.2 -std=c++23 -O2, native has -march=native; random interleaved samebinary control, per-core lock; frequency not fixed
position/report.json.rationale: Native fullmain large cases are effectively within control variation (~±0.3% for max_random and many_points). Generic fullmain also lacks consistent effect: mask random01 +1.5%; popcount max_random00 +1.9% vs control+0.4%. The isolated arithmetic reduction improvement does not justify added ISA dispatch/code in this library. No expensive full API matrix rerun on rejected prototypes.
position/report.json.scope: 2 BPlus checked/skip tests per candidate PASS, SIMD-disabled preprocessed library tokens exactly baseline for checked/skip. Not claiming all APIs/compilers validated for these rejected prototypes.

limits: 全条件・全CPUで限界と断定しない。孤立処理の短縮を提出コード全体の成果として扱わない。現在版本体のオンラインACは未確認。
